args.title: Fix password reset email using localhost instead of production URL
args.body: File: src/notifications/templates.ts. The BASE_URL constant falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, which causes password reset (and other) email links to point at localhost in production. The fix should ensure PUBLIC_URL is properly configured/required in production environments (e.g. throw or log an error if missing in production, or ensure deployment config always sets PUBLIC_URL) so that passwordResetEmail and other link-generating functions in this file produce a reachable production URL instead of silently falling back to localhost.
